enrol.title: Set up this phone

error.codeUsed: Ask at the laptop for a new QR code. This code is no longer valid.
error.noConnection: Check that you are on the festival WiFi. This phone cannot reach the laptop.

enrol.orderHeld: The order you had started is still here. It comes back on the screen as soon as the phone is set up.

enrolCode.title: Set up with the six digit code
enrolCode.intro: Enter the six digit code shown on the laptop.
enrolCode.validity: The code is valid for five minutes and for one phone.

error.wrong: Read the six digits from the laptop again. This code is not correct.
error.retired: Ask at the laptop for a new QR code. This code was entered wrongly too often and is not accepted any more.

header.reconnecting: No connection to the laptop. The app keeps trying.

catalog.title: Take an order
catalog.itemSoldOut: Ask the guest whether they would like something else. {name} has just sold out.
catalog.lineStationNoLongerPreparesIt: This station no longer prepares this item.

estimates.loadFailed: The waiting times could not be loaded. The order can still be sent.

line.whereHelp: The choice applies to this item only.

review.title: Check the order
review.sendAndSettle: Send the order and settle it
review.removeLinesThatCannotBeOrdered: Remove the items that cannot be ordered
review.sendFailed: The laptop could not be reached. Tap "Send again".
review.sendFailedDatabase: The laptop could not save the order. Send it again.
review.sendInterrupted: It is not clear whether the order arrived. Tap "Send again".
review.sendFailedTwiceUnknown: The laptop did not answer either time. The order may have arrived anyway.
review.sendFailedTwiceWriteItDown: Write the order on a slip of paper and check the tablet at the station.
review.conflictingChange: Somebody else changed something at the same moment. Try again.

order.cannotBeProcessed: The order could not be processed. Take it to the station yourself.
order.draftLost: The order you had started could not be read. Enter it again.
order.stationNotAssignedToItem: That station does not prepare this item. Take it off the order and add it again.
order.unknownItem: One item is no longer on the menu. Take it off the order.
order.settlementNoItemsSelected: Choose the items you want to settle first.
order.settlementTooManyItemsSelected: Settle the table in several steps. This is too many items at once.
order.settlementCannotBeProcessed: The settlement could not be processed. Write on a slip of paper what the table paid.
order.settlementUnknownItem: Reload the list. The laptop no longer knows one of the selected items, so nothing was settled.

openItems.title: Open items
openItems.empty: Nothing is open. Every table is settled.
openItems.loadFailed: Tap "Reload the list". The laptop could not be reached, so this list may be out of date.
openItems.amountPaidTitle: How much did the table pay?
openItems.reasonPlaceholder: For example: food for the band
openItems.givenAwayHeading: Not collected in the last 24 hours: {amount}
openItems.givenAwayHelp: These items were given away, or the table paid less than they cost.
openItems.listIncomplete: Ask at the table what is still open. This list is missing {count} item, because the laptop can no longer find the order it belongs to. | Ask at the table what is still open. This list is missing {count} items, because the laptop can no longer find the orders they belong to.
openItems.someWereAlreadySettled: Somebody else had already settled {count} item in your selection. Check whether you took money for it and give that money back to the guest. | Somebody else had already settled {count} items in your selection. Check whether you took money for them and give that money back to the guest.
openItems.otherPhonesWereNotTold: The items are settled. The other phones were not told, so their list may still be out of date.
openItems.settleFailed: Try again. Settling did not work.
openItems.settleAnswerNeverCame: It is not clear whether the settlement arrived. Reload the list and check whether the items are still open.

admin.notOnLaptop: Press "Open the admin pages" in the Ordering system window on the laptop. The admin pages do not open on a phone.

overview.title: Overview
overview.ready: Everything is set up. You can now set up the phones and the tablets.
overview.missingStation: Add at least one station to this festival, for example Kitchen and Bar.
overview.missingCategory: Create at least one category, for example Food and Drinks.
overview.missingItems: Put items on this festival's menu and fill in their prices.
overview.itemsWithoutStation: Give {count} item a station. Without one it cannot be ordered. | Give {count} items a station. Without one they cannot be ordered.
overview.stationWithoutTablet: Set the tablet up for {name}. Without a tablet this station cannot see its orders.
overview.addressChanged: Set every phone up again. The laptop's address was {previous} and is now {current}.
overview.noFestivalPicked: Open the festival you are working on under "Festivals".
overview.noFestivalIsRunning: No festival is running. Look under "Festivals".

stations.title: Stations
stations.help: A station is a kitchen or a bar. Each station gets a tablet that shows the orders it has to prepare.
stations.deactivateBody: The station disappears from the list and takes no more orders. The orders placed so far stay saved. You can switch the station back on later.
stations.removeBody: The station leaves this festival only. At every other festival it stays where it is.
stations.noFestivalPicked: Stations belong to a festival. Open one under "Festivals".

items.title: Items
items.priceInvalid: Enter the price in euros, for example 3.50.
items.deactivateBody: The item disappears from the phones and can no longer be ordered. The orders placed so far stay saved. You can activate it again later.
items.putOnTheMenuTitle: Put the item on the menu
items.noFestivalPicked: Prices and stations belong to a festival. Open one under "Festivals".

tables.title: Tables
tables.help: These names appear as suggestions on the phone. A waiter can always type a different table.
tables.fromLastSession: Add the table names from the last event

staff.title: Waiters
staff.nameMissing: Give the waiter a name before you save.
staff.renameHelp: Change the name when a waiter mistyped it. The new name is used from the next order onwards.
staff.activate: Put the waiter back on the list
staff.deactivateTitle: Take this waiter off the list?
staff.deactivateBody: The name disappears from the list and the enrolled phone is signed out. The orders placed so far stay saved. You can put the waiter back on the list later.

enrol.title: Set up a phone
enrol.validity: The QR code is valid for five minutes and for one device.
enrol.doneStation: The tablet at {name} is set up.
enrol.expired: Create a new QR code. This one was not scanned for five minutes.
enrol.codeRetired: Create a new QR code. The six digit code was entered wrongly too often and is not accepted any more.
enrol.copyUnavailable: Type the address above by hand. Copying does not work on this page.
enrol.forSomebodyNew: Scan this QR code with the phone camera. Then enter the name on the phone.
enrol.forSomebodyKnown: Scan this QR code with the phone camera.
enrol.forStation: Scan this QR code with the camera of the tablet at {name}.
enrol.qrAlt: QR code for setting the device up
enrol.qrAlreadyUsed: Create a new QR code. This one has already been used by a device.
enrol.qrReplaced: Use the newer QR code. This one was replaced when a newer one was created.
enrol.qrUnavailable: Create a new QR code. This one cannot be shown any more.
enrol.qrUnreachable: Reload the page. The laptop did not deliver the QR code.

backup.title: Backup
backup.done: Copy the file {name} onto a USB stick. It holds the whole history and is in the folder {path}.
backup.openFolderHint: Open the folder from the program window, under Settings, with "Open the data folder".
backup.help: Create the backup file with this button. Copying the database file while the program is running can leave out the most recent orders.

diagnostics.title: Technical details
diagnostics.logHelp: This holds what the program did this evening. The file helps when a station received nothing.

admin.loadFailed: Reload the page. The data could not be loaded.
admin.itemsWouldHaveNoStation: Give {count} item a different station first, or take it off the menu. Otherwise it is left with no station and cannot be ordered. | Give {count} items a different station first, or take them off the menu. Otherwise they are left with no station and cannot be ordered.

categories.name: Category name
categories.deactivateBody: The category disappears from the phones. The orders placed so far stay saved. You can switch the category on again later.
categories.noneYet: Click "New category". There is no category to choose yet.
categories.sharedAcrossFestivals: Every festival shares these categories. Rename one here and it is renamed at every festival.

admin.itemNameMissing: Give the item a name before you save it.
admin.categoryNameMissing: Give the category a name before you save.
admin.categoryNameTaken: There is already a category with this name. Choose a different one.
admin.categoryColourInvalid: Choose a colour before you save.
admin.categoryHasActiveItems: This category still has items switched on. Switch the items off first, then the category.
admin.itemCategoryUnknown: Choose a category before you save.
admin.itemCategoryIsOff: This category is switched off. Switch the category on first.
admin.itemNeedsAStation: Choose at least one station for the item.
admin.stationHasUnfinishedItems: This station still has one unfinished order and cannot be switched off yet. Finish that order and try again afterwards. | This station still has unfinished orders and cannot be switched off yet. Finish the orders and try again afterwards.
admin.stationNameMissing: Give the station a name before you save it.
admin.actionFailed: That did not work. Try again, and reload the page if it still does not work.
admin.festivalPeriodInvalid: The end has to come after the start. Set the end to a later time.
admin.festivalOverlaps: The festival {name} overlaps this period. Move the start or the end.
admin.itemPriceOutOfRange: Enter a price between 0.00 and 999.99 euros.
admin.stationHasOrdersAtTheFestival: This station has already taken {count} order at this festival. Switch it off if nobody is working there any more. | This station has already taken {count} orders at this festival. Switch it off if nobody is working there any more.

festivals.title: Festivals
festivals.help: Every festival is created on this page. The phones and the tablets follow whichever one is running now.
festivals.name: Festival name
festivals.copyHelp: The new festival starts with the same stations, items and prices. Fill in the name, the start and the end below.
festivals.hideBody: The festival disappears from the list. The orders placed so far stay saved.
festivals.noneYet: No festival has been set up yet. Click "New festival".

station.singleHeading: Items that go out as they are ready
station.empty: There is nothing to prepare right now.
station.loadFailed: Reload the page. The laptop could not be reached, so this list may be out of date.
station.actionFailed: Try again. The change was not saved.
station.actionNotReached: Tap again. The laptop could not be reached, so nothing was changed.
station.statusAlreadyPassed: Reload the page. This item is already further along than it shows here.
station.itemNotAtThisStation: Reload the page. This item does not belong to this station.
station.noItemsSelected: Tap an item. Nothing was selected, so nothing was changed.
station.deliveryAsItComes: Goes out as it is ready
station.finishAll: Mark the whole order as ready
station.finishedNotice: Ready for {table}. Write the table on the tray.
station.notPartOfTheFestival: This station is not part of the festival that is running.

startingUp.laptopNotReached: The laptop is not answering. Try again.
startingUp.couldNotStart: The laptop did not answer properly. Try again.

welcome.title: This device is not set up yet.

enrolment.nameMissing: Enter your name so the kitchen knows who took the order.
enrolment.codeUnknown: The laptop does not know this code. Ask for a new code at the laptop.
enrolment.codeNoLongerValid: This code is no longer valid. Ask for a new code at the laptop.
enrolment.codeMissing: Scan the QR code on the laptop again. This page was opened without a code.
enrolment.staffMemberIsOffTheList: Ask for a new QR code at the laptop. This waiter is no longer on the list.
enrolment.stationIsOffTheList: Ask for a new QR code at the laptop. This station is switched off.
enrolment.atMostOneOwner: Choose either a waiter or a station, not both. A QR code belongs to at most one of the two.

auth.wrongDeviceKind: This device is not set up for this screen. Have it set up again at the laptop.

session.unsupportedLanguage: The program does not have that language. Choose German or English.
session.tooManyRequests: Wait a moment and try again. The laptop is getting too many requests at once.
